description: This Java class 'ConnectionConflictStrategy' handles conflicts encountered during 'CreateConnection' commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract strategy to process conflict scenarios by logging an info message and returning a conflict exception result.

classes.name: ConnectionConflictStrategy
classes.description: Handles connection conflict scenarios during 'CreateConnection' commands by logging and returning a conflict exception result.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to process the conflict by logging an info message and creating a conflict exception result.
